notes.title: Massive New Content! Major V1.20 Update Is Here!
notes.content:
Thank you to all of you who love "Island Robot Farm"! In this update, we've prepared a ton of new content for everyone to enjoy. Steamhappy thanks you for your love and patience. The update details are as follows:
[p align="start"]\[New Content]
[olist]
New Building: Giant Granary - Sell plants without queuing.

New Building: Oil Pump - Obtain crude oil, with bonuses when used with Dark Soil Plots.

New Building: Birdhouse - Can be used to raise seabirds.

New Building: BGM Player - Adjust the game's background music.

Added 1 lighting structure and 1 decorative structure.
[/olist][p align="start"]\[Bug Fixes & Optimizations]
[olist]
After building the Botanical Research Institute, a quick-access button is added to the toolbar.

Fixed several known issues and adjusted some UI elements.
[/olist][p align="start"]Finally, thank you to all players worldwide for your love and support! I will continue to develop new content in the coming time. I hope you have fun playing the game and find that sense of "tranquility" that belongs to you within it!

notes.title: Island Robot Farm Official Version 7th Update
notes.content:
We are pleased to bring you the 7th official update (v1.07), with continuous optimizations to enhance your gaming experience. Here are the details:



[olist]
Optimized robot behavior logic
When robots perform tasks such as land reclamation, building construction, or building demolition, they will first complete all pending tasks of the same type before moving on to other tasks in the task list. If power runs out, they will still prioritize recharging.

Optimizations for farms

Adjusted farm values

Improved judgment of robot transportation positions for farms

New reminder feature
Added unlock reminders for Level 3 buildings to help you track progress more easily.

Adjusted early-game building costs
Optimized the purchase prices of some buildings in the early stages to make initial development smoother.

Fixed robot stuttering issue
Resolved the rare case where flying robots get stuck while constructing buildings.

Other optimizations
Fixed some known issues and improved content formatting.
[/olist]

It's been one day since the game was released, and we've received a lot of feedback from the community. Thank you all so much for your love and support! This update addresses the following issues:

notes.title: 🚀🚀[Island Robot Farm] Is Now Available! Build Your Own Island!
notes.content:
Greetings, farmers! The relaxing and therapeutic sandbox factory-building game Island Robot Farm is now officially launched!

Enjoy a 10% launch discount! Bring home dozens of hours of joyful sandbox farming fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/4d5b9f21c471f69195176e8e70c739155a2b176c.jpg

The Full Version Adds Tons of New Content and Gameplay Compared to Previous Versions

1. Brand New Simulation & Management System
In the full version, we've developed a brand new simulation and management system!
This includes (but is not limited to): Beverage Factory, Vegetable Juice Factory, and more.
After progressing to a certain point in the game, you can construct new factory buildings and produce goods according to incoming orders.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/f4fb2b91774aec5094d54954bce242a7c306218d.gif

2. New Diving Station System

Among the full version's buildings, there's a brand new Diving Station structure featuring the automated Diver Dave! Simply set the collection task, and wait for the goods to arrive.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/b2d3942c61583c80dbc1badb0f0c7c0101ae5ae0.gif

3. New Rocket System

In the full version, farmers can also experience a bit of "Kerbal Space Program". After building the Rocket structure, click launch to embark on interstellar colonization! (The little robots that fly into space will explore, mine, and bring back unique alien plants – like the Mars Flower, a specialty of Mars!)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/643bddd002dc77ff19197db0f16846d78e3cedcd.gif

4. More and Cuter New Robots!
For the full version, we've gathered suggestions from our vast community of farmers and created even more adorable little robots! And each one has a significant role to play!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/6337eb51f99605faeef63bb1d2a45c400212bc46.png

Plus, the full version is packed with even more rich content, waiting for you "farmers" to discover!

notes.title: Island Robot Farm: First Update Announcement for the Next Fest
notes.content:
Dear Farmers,

Hello! We sincerely thank you for your enthusiastic support and valuable feedback for "Island Robot Farm" during the Next Fest! To provide you with a smoother and more comfortable gaming experience, we have released the first minor update. This update primarily focuses on optimizing interface displays. The details are as follows:

Main Update Contents

Optimized UI reminders and displays for the game window interface.

Optimized font display for resource information at the top of the screen.

Our Commitment

Although this update is minor in scale, its purpose is to address some visual and usability issues encountered by players during the initial experience, thereby enhancing overall comfort. We fully understand this is just the beginning. Our development team will continue to closely monitor your feedback and bring more optimizations, new content, and fixes in future updates.

Welcome to join our Discord community group (https://discord.gg/NmzAYFQ9HP) to share your feedback and discuss!

notes.title: Island Robot Farm: Live at Steam Next Fest! Download Now!
notes.content:
Hi, Cyber Farmers!

Island Robot Farm will participate in the upcoming Steam Next Fest (June 10th - June 17th). The Demo version for this festival comes packed with tons of new content. Welcome, all Cyber Farmers, to experience and try it out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/6103e4cceeda82166e0551bc406cb1c23f6a877b.gif

Island Robot Farm is a relaxing and therapeutic idle game focused on production lines – perfect for idle moments! A must-have for slacking off!

Here, you can play the role of a "Cyber Farmer," assigning tasks to your diligent "Cattle and Horse Robots," arranging for them to grow plants, raise animals, and construct various buildings, gradually expanding your island territory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/6262ba25b9839852f4e62b1678b93a78134914fe.gif

The Demo for this Next Fest also includes a wealth of brand-new content, allowing you to experience:

1、Added a new "Ranch" feature – you can now raise small animals on the island!

2、Added new "Cattle and Horse Robots" to help you better manage your island.

3、Added several new decorative items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351807/5147d19e7d65786e687703d0d0bfceeb844c1031.gif

Finally, a huge thank you to everyone for trying out the game! There may still be many shortcomings or areas needing improvement. We encourage you to actively share your suggestions or feedback~
(If you like our game, we'd be thrilled if you added it to your wishlist!)

Join our Discord Community: https://discord.gg/NmzAYFQ9HP
